text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making it virtually impossible that your sex was the deciding factor. 

While an all-male panel may breach civil service diversity guidelines regarding panel composition, it does not demonstrate unlawful sex discrimination against you when another male candidate was appointed. Raising gender bias in this context would appear unsubstantiated and could harm your professional standing in the civil service. 

Instead, focus on the legitimate procedural issue: follow up politely on your delayed written feedback. Requesting your detailed competency scores will help you understand how the panel weighed specific criteria—such as international project experience—against your credentials and background.
